employment_type.text: What is the type of employment?

option.UNEMPLOYED_NOT_LOOKING_FOR_WORK: Unemployed - not actively looking for work

STABLE.hint: They may have had a break in employment due to things like redundancy, illness or caring for a family member.

option.PERIODS_OF_INSTABILITY: Generally in employment but changes jobs often
option.UNSTABLE: Unstable employment history with regular periods of unemployment

employment_area.text: What job sector does %1 work in? (optional)

employment_education_changes.text: Does %1 want to make changes to their employment and education?
employment_education_changes.validation: Select if they want to make changes to their employment and education

employment_other_responsibilities.text: Does %1 have any additional day-to-day commitments?
employment_other_responsibilities.validation: Select if they have any additional day-to-day commitments, or select 'None'

education_highest_level_completed.text: Select the highest level of academic qualification %1 has completed

LEVEL_1.hint: For example, GCSE grades 3, 2, 1 or grades D, E, F, G.

LEVEL_2.hint: For example, GCSE grades 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4 or grades A*, A, B, C.

education_highest_level_completed.validation: Select the highest level of academic qualification completed

education_professional_or_vocational_qua.text: Does %1 have any professional or vocational qualifications?
education_professional_or_vocational_qua.validation: Select if they have any professional or vocational qualifications

education_transferable_skills.text: Does %1 have any skills that could help them in a job or to get a job?

YES.hint: This includes any completed training, qualifications, work experience or transferable skills.

YES_SOME_SKILLS.hint: This includes partially completed training or qualifications, limited on the job experience or skills that are not directly transferable.

NO.hint: This includes having no other qualifications, incomplete apprenticeships or no history of working in the same industry.

education_transferable_skills.validation: Select if they have any skills that could help them in a job or to get a job
